title: (Pwn2Own) ICONICS Genesis64 IcoFwxServer Deserialization Of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ICONICS Genesis64. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists with the handling of serialized objects. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
